description: This source file contains a command-line utility for processing, pruning, and transforming JUnit XML test result files, specifically tailored for Kubernetes testing workflows.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that processes command-line arguments, reads XML files, and applies pruning and streaming functions.

methods.name: pruneXML
methods.description: Prunes test case messages and failure contents in JUnit test suites to limit size, and filters log output to exclude klog entries.

methods.name: pruneStringIfNeeded
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum byte size, adding a clipping notice.

methods.name: pruneTESTS
methods.description: Condenses test suites by extracting package name and nesting test cases accordingly, and merges failure info.

methods.name: joinTexts
methods.description: Joins two text strings with appropriate separator, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: fetchXML
methods.description: Decodes XML data into JUnitTestSuites structure.

methods.name: streamXML
methods.description: Encodes JUnitTestSuites structure into XML and writes to output.
